# The Lore

The Lore has five parts and one manifest file. Each part is a folder with its own index. Read the index of a part when you need that part, and open a file only when you need its content.

- [space.md](./space.md): the Space's manifest, which names the Space, its GitHub repository and Project, its repositories and its publish areas.
- [corpus/](./corpus/index.md): what the words mean in this Space, one entry per concept, read when the word comes up.
- [verbs/](./verbs/index.md): what the AI Agent can do when asked, one action per file, read when the verb is invoked.
- [processes/](./processes/index.md): how verbs and decisions are sequenced, with the steps that need the Human Lead's yes, read when the process is run.
- [contracts/](./contracts/index.md): what must never happen, as a rule and, where one is possible, a check script that the AI engine runs before or after a write.
- [mirrors/](./mirrors/index.md): what each payload looks like and where things go in it, read before writing to the payload.
